title: answer with a tiered model stack (router): paid tier added under Atom's rule
what: Atom's rule (STANDING.md, 2026-09-28): the free ceiling is not a stop, but Void pays only from money it has already earned, never from an outside top-up, and every spend needs a yes on the confirm line. The router now sends a hard ask (or an ask the free allowance can't answer) to DeepSeek V4 Flash only when the earned budget is above zero AND an approved standing spend (confirm-line tool models.spend) has room; each call's cost is counted against the cap and the budget and written to void_ledger. Supersedes the earlier record's 'DeepSeek V4 Flash is never called'. Otherwise Qwen 3.8 27B on the free allocation, else Gemma, and 'would escalate' is logged.
